title: Spectral Analysis of Brownian Motion with its Rheological Analogues
summary: The power spectrum of the Brownian motion of probe microparticles with mass m and radius R immersed in a viscoelastic material reveals valuable information about repetitive patterns and correlation structures that manifest in the frequency domain.
